name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – § 124
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: Considers that joint borrowing presents a viable option that offers the Union the ability to respond swiftly to unexpected developments and facilitates the timely financing of EU policies with clear EU added value; emphasises that such an option should be fully in line with the EU’s strategic priorities for European public goods, or facilitate investment in cross-border or pan-European projects that boost the EU’s growth potential;
